ideas.pitch: Real-time indoor AR wayfinding and spatial onboarding tool for large convention centers and high schools.
ideas.title: NovaAR Indoor Nav
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the successful AR-onboarding and low-latency workflow pattern from BaseScanning to create an immediately impressive, hardware-integrated mobile live demo.

ideas.pitch: Computer-vision posture and ergonomics analyzer providing instant feedback for student desk workers.
ideas.title: BioStance AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven formula of CricketVision_AI by combining MediaPipe pose estimation with a fast local classification model for a highly visual live demo.

ideas.pitch: Satellite and aerial imagery change detection dashboard to monitor urban land use and environmental shifts in Northern Virginia.
ideas.title: EcoWatch Alexandria
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the GeoNex-ATLAS pattern of processing geospatial data into a polished, high-utility dashboard that appeals directly to civic and environmental judges.

ideas.pitch: Personalized meal planning app that maps ingredients directly to local grocery store inventories and dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: NutriPrep Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the consumer-facing utility and rapid deployment speed of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant into a localized context with clear commercial and everyday value.

ideas.pitch: Predictive incident forecasting tool for campus safety patrols utilizing historical data and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: RiskMap AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous data science methodologies like Poisson regression and confidence intervals, mirroring the technical depth that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.
